work.heading: Turning complex technology into measurable business outcomes
work.description: Focused on reusable platform capability, not buzzwords — every system is judged on stability, efficiency, and cost.

items.title: AI Platform & Multi-Agent Hub
items.summary: Built an enterprise multi-agent platform with LangGraph, Agno, and Dify, combining RAG, SFT, Planner-ReAct orchestration, and dynamic tool calling. Delivered Deep Research, PPT Agent, and multimodal capabilities, plus an RLHF-inspired Prompt Auto-Evolution loop for generation, scoring, feedback, and policy updates.
items.result: Improved complex-task handling and customer support efficiency, with substantially less manual prompt tuning

items.title: Desktop & Server Code Agent Infrastructure
items.summary: Built a Tauri / Rust desktop workbench with a Node.js sidecar and the Cline SDK, a versioned JSONL protocol, streaming interaction, and three-tier tool approvals. The server combines Cline Core, an Agent Gateway, WebSocket, Redis, Celery, and Docker for task scheduling, sandbox orchestration, and worker registration and authentication.
items.result: Code search, execution, patching, multi-turn correction, and multiple models, with human approval, reconnect, isolated execution, and container reclamation

items.title: End-to-End AI Video Production System
items.summary: Led an end-to-end pipeline for LLM script generation, task orchestration, inference, KEDA-driven elastic GPU scheduling, and automated editing. Combined cost optimization and resource forecasting to support large-scale concurrent video generation.
items.result: Overall compute cost down 30%+, throughput significantly improved

items.title: Billion-Scale AI Data Lake
items.summary: Built offline and real-time resume pools with Flink + Hudi, unified feature KV, behavior, and experiment data, optimized feature storage with Codis + Pika, and served non-hot data from MongoDB.
items.result: Reduced online load, cut offline-pool cost by 33%, and saved 80% of feature-storage memory

items.title: Model Engineering Platform & LLM Proxy
items.summary: Built a Kubeflow-inspired platform on Argo Workflow for experiments, training, storage, evaluation, and deployment; used LLM Proxy to monitor quality and cost across OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and DeepSeek.

items.title: Big Data & AI Task Platform
items.summary: Built batch and streaming task scheduling on Amazon EMR, Kubernetes, and Argo Workflow, with Jupyter + Livy + Spark for data preparation and exploration. Combined KEDA GPU scheduling with multiprocessing for PDF parsing, inference, and ffmpeg media tasks.
items.result: At least 30% faster feature work and 50%+ lower cost for inference and media tasks

foundations.heading: Engineering foundations behind the AI systems

items.title: UGC recommendation service
items.description: Built automotive UGC recommendations with Redis sorted sets, gevent, and caching, achieving P99 of 30 ms at peak 6,000 QPS. Developed feeds with Bloom-filter deduplication, history backfill, HOT TOP K, fallback, and automatic degradation.

items.title: Search suggestion service
items.description: Combined Go, tries, and heaps for prefix suggestions and trending searches, with asynchronous data refresh and in-process caching.

items.title: Open-source contributions
items.description: Integrated app, model, and data modules and knowledge-completion algorithms, providing runnable examples from training through testing.

items.title: Knowledge-graph Q&A for children
items.description: Built Q&A services with Nginx, Lua, uWSGI, and Beego. Reduced average response time through request routing and POST caching, with hot-swappable trie suggestions, rate limiting, Bloom filters, null caching, and optimized multi-key reads.

items.title: Annotation logs & behavior analysis
items.description: Collected node-level annotation logs with Filebeat DaemonSets, relayed through Kafka, aggregated with Logstash, and indexed in Elasticsearch to analyze annotation behavior and improve the user experience.

items.title: Campaign components & performance monitoring
items.description: Built reusable PV/UV, voting, points, red-packet, and live-comment components. Red-packet components ran at 10,000 QPS and 100 concurrent requests per machine. Built online campaign profiling with Xhprof and Flume + Kafka + Spark Streaming.

experience.heading: Built and validated in real business contexts

items.detail: Lead AI platform architecture and application development across multi-agent systems, coding agents, model engineering, and enterprise AI workflows.
Owned data lake, big data platform, and machine learning platform; consistently top performance ratings.

Led backend development and production delivery, building high-performance shared components and standardized engineering practices. Promoted single-responsibility and KISS principles, automation, and knowledge documentation; awarded Institute Employee of the Year.

Developed and optimized backend architecture and service modules for the automotive vertical, planned project delivery, and maintained service stability; awarded the department’s “Fearless Challenger” award.
Built a campaign performance monitoring platform; contributed to interactive campaign development for Tencent Ads' Wind Chime system.
Maintained and shipped business-layer code for Baidu's Phoenix Nest system.
